name: Union-Closed Directed-Graph Construction
definition: For a finite loopless digraph $G$, use three controls, one private coordinate per vertex, and two feedback coordinates $a_e,b_e$ per arc. Before complementing all coordinates, the decreasing control fibers are: the full cube at empty support; the cube minus $011$ at a vertex; $c_1\le c_2$ at $a_e$; $c_1\le c_3$ at $b_e$; both inequalities at $\{a_e,b_e\}$; $\{000\}$ when the source vertex is joined to any nonempty feedback support of its arc; $\{111\}$ for the target; and empty otherwise.
parameters: Finite loopless directed graph without repeated arcs; opposite arcs are allowed.
properties: For $m$ vertices and $e$ arcs, it is union closed, convex-realizable, dismantlable ample, and finite convex-treelike, with $m+2e+3$ coordinates and $8+7m+23e$ concepts. Its VC dimension is four when $e>0$ and three when $e=0$.
